headline: Microsoft Teams moves to a new standard-connector pack; the identity.* modeling-rule sweep finishes
summary_md:
- **MicrosoftGraphTeams** loses 732 lines against 12 added while a new **MicrosoftGraphTeamsStandardConnector** pack appears at +287/-0 — the day's one structural move.
- The `identity.*` modeling-rule series ends: PR 7 of 7 lands for both CRTX-271525 and CRTX-271527, alongside PRs 3, 5 and 6.
- 25 of the 37 packs added lines against **exactly one deletion each**, that sweep's signature shape.
- Five substantive fixes landed — **Bitbucket** authentication, **Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps** watermarking, **Elasticsearch** Kibana URL, **Zscaler** 401 handling, and an **Enterprise DLP** argument.
- 37 packs, 6,365 lines added against 1,599 removed, from 15 upstream commits.

highlights.title: The Microsoft Teams integration is re-homed into a standard-connector pack
highlights.detail: MicrosoftGraphTeams is the only pack losing substantially more than it gains (+12/-732) on the same day a new MicrosoftGraphTeamsStandardConnector pack is added with no deletions at all, so existing Teams content moves rather than changes.

highlights.title: Bitbucket gains new authentication methods in a near-total rewrite
highlights.detail: At +569/-597 it is the only pack that removed roughly as much as it added, so the existing auth path was replaced rather than extended.

highlights.title: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps fixes a stalled event-type watermark
highlights.detail: XSUP-72224, a support-raised collector bug where the fetch watermark stopped advancing, plus a now-configurable fetch limit (+511/-33).

highlights.title: ApiModules is the day's largest single change at +1,418
highlights.detail: It carries one deletion, the additive shape of the modeling-rule sweep, but no commit subject names it.

highlights.title: The identity.* modeling-rule series reaches PR 7 of 7
highlights.detail: Both CRTX-271525 and CRTX-271527 land their final part today after PRs 2 through 6 landed on 1 September, closing a sweep that has touched packs across two days.

highlights.title: Phishing reworks a reported-email deletion path
highlights.detail: At +333/-169 it is the day's second-largest rework, and the commit list carries a migration of SecurityAndComplianceV2 off the DeleteReportedEmail script to Microsoft Graph Security eDiscovery.

items.Packs/MicrosoftGraphTeams: Loses 732 lines against 12 added as Teams content moves to a standard-connector pack.
items.Packs/MicrosoftGraphTeamsStandardConnect: New pack, +287/-0, added as the msgraphteams standard connector.
items.Packs/Bitbucket: New authentication methods, replacing most of the pack (+569/-597).
items.Packs/ApiModules: The day's largest pack change at +1,418/-1; no commit subject names it.
items.Packs/MicrosoftCloudAppSecurity: Fixes the XSUP-72224 stalled event-type watermark and makes the fetch limit configurable (+511/-33).
items.Packs/Phishing: Reworked at +333/-169, against a SecurityAndComplianceV2 migration to Microsoft Graph Security eDiscovery.
items.Packs/Elasticsearch: Adds a Kibana Server URL parameter, XSUP-76053 (+103/-23).
items.Packs/Palo_Alto_Networks_Enterprise_DLP: Adds a service_name argument to pan-dlp-get-report (+105/-9).
items.Packs/Zscaler: ZscalerZIdentity now handles an HTTP 401 response (+64/-3).
items.Packs/Unit42ThreatIntelligencebyPaloAlto: Updates the feed's outbound requests documentation (+15/-1).
items.Packs/OpenAI: Largest of the one-deletion additive packs after ApiModules, +372/-1.
items.Packs/Kiteworks: Additive change in the sweep's shape, +334/-1.
items.Packs/HuaweiFW: Additive change in the sweep's shape, +237/-1.
items.Packs/ForcepointEmailSecurity: Additive change in the sweep's shape, +209/-1.
